title: Assessing the Origins of Islamic Revelation

items.title: The Initial Encounter: Violence and Compulsion

islamic_quotes.quote: The angel **caught me (forcefully) and pressed me so hard that I could not bear it any more**. He then released me and again asked me to read and I replied, 'I do not know how to read.' Thereupon he **caught me again and pressed me a second time** till I could not bear it any more... Thereupon he **caught me for the third time and pressed me**...

Then the Angel **held me (forcibly) and pressed me so hard that I felt distressed**. Then he released me and again asked me to read, and I replied, 'I do not know how to read.' Thereupon he **held me again and pressed me for the second time** till I felt distressed. He then released me and asked me to read, but again I replied. 'I do not know how to read.' Thereupon he **held me for the third time and pressed me till I got distressed**...

He **took hold of me [the Apostle said] and pressed me, till I was hard pressed**; thereafter he let me off and said: Recite. I said: I am not lettered. He then again **took hold of me and pressed me for the second time till I was hard pressed**... He **took hold of me and pressed me for the third time, till I was hard pressed**...

He **pressed me with it so tightly that I thought it was death**; then he let me go and said, ‘Read!’ I said, ‘What shall I read?’ He **pressed me with it again so that I thought it was death**; then he let me go and said, ‘Read!’ ... He **pressed me with it the third time so that I thought it was death** ... and this I said only to **deliver myself from him, lest he should do the same to me again**.

biblical_parallels.quote: Teacher, I brought You my son, possessed with a spirit which makes him mute; and **whenever it seizes him, it slams him to the ground** and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth and stiffens out.
and **a spirit seizes him**, and he suddenly screams, and it **throws him into a convulsion** with foaming at the mouth; and only with difficulty does it leave him, **battering him as it leaves**.

biblical_expectations.quote: And I heard the voice of a man ... 'Gabriel, cause that one to understand the vision.' ... and I was terrified and fell upon my face ... **he touched me, and set me on my feet**.
Then this one with human appearance **touched me again and strengthened me**. He said, 'O man of high esteem, do not be afraid. **Peace be with you; take courage** and be courageous!'
Zacharias was troubled when he saw [the angel], and fear gripped him. But the angel said to him, '**Do not be afraid**, Zacharias, for your petition has been heard...'
But she was very perplexed at [this] statement... The angel said to her, '**Do not be afraid**, Mary; for you have found favor with God.'

items.closing_thought: A stark theological divergence emerges here: whereas biblical angelic encounters consistently de-escalate fear and restore the prophet's faculties, the initial revelation at Hira is characterized by intense physical subjugation and mortal distress.

items.title: Severe Psychological Torment and Suicidal Ideation

islamic_quotes.quote: Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned with the Inspiration, **his neck muscles twitching with terror** till he entered upon Khadija and said, **'Cover me! Cover me!'** They covered him till his fear was over and then he said, 'O Khadija, what is wrong with me?' ... the Prophet (ﷺ) became so sad as we have heard that **he intended several times to throw himself from the tops of high mountains** and every time he went up the top of a mountain in order to throw himself down, Gabriel would appear before him and say, 'O Muhammad! You are indeed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in truth'...

Then the Prophet returned therewith, **his heart was trembling**, and he went to Khadija and said: **Wrap me up, wrap me up!** So they wrapped him till the fear had left him. He then said to Khadija: O Khadija! what has happened to me? and he informed her of the happening, saying: **I fear for myself.**

Now none of God's creatures was more hateful to me than an (ecstatic) poet or a man possessed: I could not even look at them. I thought, **Woe is me poet or possessed** — Never shall Quraysh say this of me! **I will go to the top of the mountain and throw myself down that I may kill myself and gain rest.**

biblical_parallels.quote: a man from the tombs with an unclean spirit met Him ... **constantly, night and day, he was screaming among the tombs and in the mountains, and gashing himself with stones.**

immediately **the spirit threw him into a convulsion**, and falling to the ground, he [began] rolling around and foaming [at the mouth] ... **It has often thrown him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him.**
And the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and **an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him.**

Then the devil took Him into the holy city and had Him stand on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, '**If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down**; for it is written, \'HE WILL COMMAND HIS ANGELS CONCERNING YOU\'; and \'ON [their] HANDS THEY WILL BEAR YOU UP, SO THAT YOU WILL NOT STRIKE YOUR FOOT AGAINST A STONE.\''

biblical_expectations.quote: [Elijah] requested for himself that he might die, and said, 'It is enough... take my life' ... He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, **there was an angel touching him, and he said to him, 'Arise, eat.'**
**For he shall give his angels charge concerning you, to keep you in all your ways. They shall bear you up on their hands, lest at any time you dash your foot against a stone.**

items.closing_thought: This psychological aftermath warrants careful consideration. In biblical precedent, divine encounters restore purpose and clarity, whereas severe torment and suicidal ideation are consistently associated with adversarial spiritual forces.

items.title: Physiological Manifestations: Mediumship vs. Prophecy

comparatives.theme: Loss of Bodily Control and Extreme Heaviness

islamic_quotes.quote: Sometimes it is (revealed) **like the ringing of a bell**, this form of Inspiration is the **hardest of all** and then this state passes off after I have grasped what is inspired... Verily I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) being inspired divinely on a very cold day and noticed the **sweat dropping from his forehead**.
(He, the Holy Prophet) **sweated in cold weather**, and **his face became red**.
I was sitting beside the Prophet (ﷺ) and his knee was on my knee and then the Divine Inspiration was revealed to him and **his thigh became so heavy that I was afraid my thigh would be broken**.

When the chapter of Al-Ma'ida was sent down, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was on his camel and I was holding the halter of the camel. **The fore-legs of the camel almost broke down due to the heaviness** of the chapter.
**The bell is the musical instrument of the Satan**.

Ya'la said: 'Would that I see revelation coming to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).' ... he was covered with a cloth... 'Umar lifted a corner of the cloth and I looked at him and **he was emitting a sound of snorting... I thought it was the sound of a camel**.

biblical_parallels.quote: and whenever it seizes him, **it slams him to the ground** and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth and stiffens out ... immediately the spirit **threw him into a convulsion**, and **falling to the ground, he [began] rolling around** and foaming [at the mouth].
and a spirit seizes him, and he suddenly screams, and **it throws him into a convulsion** with foaming at the mouth; and only with difficulty does it leave him, **battering him as it leaves**.

biblical_expectations.quote: I heard the sound of his words; and as soon as I heard the sound of his words, I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face to the ground. Then behold, **a hand touched me and set me trembling** on my hands and knees ... **'stand upright, for I have now been sent to you.'** And when he had spoken this word to me, I stood up trembling.
When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. And **He placed His right hand on me**, saying, **'Do not be afraid**; I am the first and the last'

items.closing_thought: These intense physiological phenomena—such as loss of bodily control, heavy snorting, and severe heaviness—warrant comparative study. Readers are encouraged to consider how this contrasts with the biblical model of prophecy, which emphasizes the preservation of a prophet's lucidity and composure.

items.title: Vulnerability to Black Magic (Sihr)

islamic_quotes.quote: **Magic was worked on Allah's Messenger** (ﷺ) so that he used to **think that he had sexual relations with his wives while he actually had not**... The one near my head asked the other, 'What is wrong with this man?' The latter replied, '**He is under the effect of magic.**' The first one asked, 'Who has worked magic on him?' The other replied, 'Labid bin Al-A'sam... With a comb and the hair stuck to it...'

A'ishah reported that a Jew from among the Jews of Banu Zuraiq who was called Labid b. al-A'sam **cast a spell upon Allah's Messenger** (ﷺ) with the result that he (under the influence of the spell) **felt that he had been doing something whereas in fact he had not been doing that**.

biblical_parallels.quote: Now there was a man named Simon, who formerly was **practicing magic in the city and astonishing the people** of Samaria... they were giving him attention because he had for a long time **astonished them with his magic arts**.

The coming of the lawless one is by the **activity of Satan with all power and false signs and wonders**, and with all wicked deception... therefore **God sends them a strong delusion**, so that they may believe what is false.

biblical_expectations.quote: **For there is no divination in Jacob, nor enchantment in Israel;** in season it shall be told to Jacob and Israel what God shall perform.
Behold, I have given you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and **over all the power of the enemy, and nothing will injure you**.

items.closing_thought: The documented susceptibility to sorcery presents a critical epistemological challenge: if a prophet's perception of reality can be successfully compromised by occult forces for an extended period, how can the integrity of their spiritual visions be reasonably assured?

items.title: Interception of the Revelation (The 'Satanic Verses')

islamic_quotes.quote: We have not sent any messenger or any prophet before you, except that, when he began to wish [recite], **Satan cast (something) into his wishful thinking [recitation]**. But God cancels what Satan casts, (and) then God clearly composes His verses – surely God is knowing, wise –

Al-Baghawi and the majority of the scholars of Tafsir said: '{he began to wish}' means **'Reciting the Book of Allah.'** '{Satan cast (something) into his wishful thinking}' means **'In his recitation.'** ... 'Ali bin Abi Talhah reported that Ibn 'Abbas said: **'When he spoke, the Shaytan threw (some falsehood) into his speech.'**

and when he came to the words: 'Have you thought upon al-Lat and al-‘Uzza and Manat, the third, the other?' **Satan cast on his tongue**, because of his inner debates and what he desired to bring to his people, the words: **'These are the high-flying cranes; verily their intercession is accepted with approval.'**
Narrated Ibn `Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated while reciting An-Najm and **with him prostrated the Muslims, the pagans, the jinns, and all human beings**.

biblical_parallels.quote: But the Spirit explicitly says that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to **deceitful spirits and doctrines of demons**, by means of the hypocrisy of liars seared in their own conscience as with a branding iron.
Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but **test the spirits to see whether they are from God**, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
He said, 'I will go out and be a **deceiving spirit in the mouth of all his prophets**.'

biblical_expectations.quote: for **no prophecy was ever made by an act of human will**, but **men moved by the Holy Spirit spoke from God**.
**no one speaking by the Spirit of God says, 'Jesus is accursed'**; and **no one can say, 'Jesus is Lord,' except by the Holy Spirit**.
You are from God, little children, and have overcome them; because **greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world**.

items.closing_thought: If the interception of prophetic speech is acknowledged in the historical record, it raises a profound theological question: what spiritual framework guarantees the divine origin and preservation of the remaining recitations?
